Subject: Recap from today's discovery — BluePeak pilot priorities & proposed milestones

Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap of the main takeaways and what we agreed to validate next: 

Pain points you described:
- Latency spikes on peak inference windows causing poor end-user experience (mobile latency > 300ms at 95th).
- Cost unpredictability across models and burst traffic.
- Need for data residency controls for EU customer segments and stricter retention policies.

Goals we aligned on:
- 95th/99th percentile token latency < 150ms for the primary intent model.
- Reduce per-API call inference cost by ~30% vs current provider over pilot workload.
- Pilot to prove production readiness and handoff to platform team in 6–8 weeks.

Proposed mutual action plan (draft):
1) Technical scoping & requirements (owner: BluePeak eng) — target complete by 2026-10-09
2) Pilot environment setup (Redwood + BluePeak infra) — target complete by 2026-10-23
3) Performance tuning & baseline runs (joint) — target complete by 2026-11-06
4) Executive review & procurement decision — target week of 2026-11-15

Open questions you flagged:
- Whether we can run the pilot in your VPC with KMS integration.
- Evidence for SOC 2 / data handling (we can share a SOC snapshot).
- Pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted routes for the pilot burst profile.

Next steps I proposed on the call: Ben (me) will circulate a short MPA draft with milestones and owners, Monica (CC) will schedule a technical scoping meeting with your infra team. Can you confirm the stakeholders who should be on the scoping call and whether our proposed dates look reasonable?

Call recording and notes: https://drive.redwood.com/bluepeak/calls/20261001 (attachment: call-recording-20261001.mp3)

Thanks —
Ben Carter

Thanks Ben — useful summary. Quick responses from our side: 

- Confirm the pain/cost goals — we want the 99th latency under 160ms for the initial pilot (happy to target 150ms as stretch).
- Stakeholders for scoping call: Joshua Kim (VP Eng) will lead infra; CC'd below. Add our data privacy lead (Priya is handling).
- VPC deployment: we prefer a VPC-hosted pilot (ability to connect to our KMS is essential).

Open asks before we lock dates: 
1) SOC 2 evidence / compliance snapshot (we must share with procurement).
2) Draft SOW or simple MPA showing milestone acceptance criteria — procurement wants clear acceptance gates.
3) Cost estimate for two scenarios: hosted trial vs dedicated reserved pilot (ballpark numbers OK).

We can do the scoping call week of Oct 11 — 2–3 people from our side (Joshua, Priya, one ML eng). If you can circulate the MPA draft with explicit acceptance criteria that would help procurement move quickly.

Regards,
Samir Nadeem
